translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nzlukr Leplz Mrbcnepwz Apule Nzyrplaokr Nrc Kxesz'

content.text: Yawe, pnzpe drtwrnge kx namnc-lrpitxpwo, a' bzkq alex alwx mz nzlctr-krbz drtwrnge bam mz nzkxpu-krngeng.
Murde kxdrka'-ngrng lcng tzmnc-aepztrpqng bange, ma tzxtrnga-ngrdr nzlqngi-krm.
X kxmule-esz' trycmnewxu,
A' nzkxpu-krngeng etunepx zvz, delc tqtalvzongr nabznge.
X mz nzaotikr drtwrnge nzkxpu-krngeng, nztalvzokr nabznge mrilvzole ninge.
X mzli kc tqrblxm bange nzmnc-lrpi-krnge, sc tqrpipebo bam kx,
“Yawe, nzlu-krnge mrbcnepwz. ?Memule tqpxlavxpx-ngrbzme nzkxpu-krnge?
?Myx mzli kx naesakingr trnzmnc-zpwx-krpwc'u lc?”
Murde nim kx amrbctrp nzlu-krnge. X mzli kx lutix ngi da txne mz nzobq-krm.
Nzlukr leplz mrbcnepwz apule nzyrplaokr nrc kxesz'.
Nzwz-katongr ngi brmrdakr apule nounc kc trpnzngr nrade.
X mz nzbzkr leplz trpnzngr dztudrng kx natwzlr.
?Kxetu nike naobqtipxx mz nzmnc-krnge lc tqngi brmrda?
Mwx namrlz nzbrti-zvzkr drtwrnge nim.
Murde na-arlapxq ninge mz alwx rngeng amrlx,
X kxnzlukurnrng ma tzyrpalelvzlr ninge.
Mzli ka, dcpxpe mz drtwrnge kx vz-rbrx nzlctr-krbz drtwrnge bam mz nzkxpu-krngeng.
Murde tubq nzayrplapx-krm ninge mz alwx rngeng.
A' bzkq ayrplatipx-zvzq ninge,
Murde ycpe pipz nzbztr-krbo mz mqm.
Mz nzayrplapx-krm leplz, odatibzme dztudrng kcng tqmrlzbz badr.
Apusr-ngrbzmeleng da kx yrti ninr,
Murde nakrlzlr kx nzvz-rbrng mz nzobq-krm.
Nzlukr leplz mrbcnepwz apule nzyrplaokr nrc kxesz'.
Yawe, xlrm nzkrka'-krnge x nzyrni-krnge.
Murde nzmrbckr nzmncngr mz nrlc apunepwzle nzwoukr betepu.
Ayrkrtxpx nzetqkr drtqnge x aotxpxbz drtqnge,
Murde mwx na-abrtztx-kaix mzli kxpipz x ninge kc tqbz ate.
